_note: Weapon attachments (mods). Hand entries first (wiki-sourced M110A1 set), then game-files bulk import (gamedata/templates guns_mods/modern_scopes/modern_items, see docs/mods.md). Each attachment belongs to a slot, lists compatible weapon ids, and carries percent modifiers keyed by wiki stat name (Aiming Speed maps to Aiming (s); percents on it apply inversely because the stat is a time). Magazine capacity overrides the weapon Magazine stat. Weight, volume and shop prices add up onto the weapon. Modifiers that hit no stat on the weapon are shown as info chips instead. Effect figures are computed from game files; suppressor loudness differs from older wiki snapshots (game files win). Screenshots: save square PNGs under public/images/mods/ (e.g. hx-qd-m110a1.png), set image to the /images/mods/... path plus an imageSource attribution URL, and the icon appears in the slot tile and picker automatically; without an image the slot glyph is used as placeholder.
